properties.description: Atal Bhujal Yojana is a central government scheme in India aimed to improve groundwater in over-exploited and ground water stressed states. The scheme monitors groundwater levels in deeper aquifers than shallow aquifers to track depletion trends, assess the impact of interventions, and promote data-driven groundwater management. Ground water level data pre and post monsoon from 2015 to 2022 hosted from [Open Government Data](https://www.data.gov.in/catalog/ground-water-level-data-under-atal-bhujal-yojana) (OGD) Platform.
